universe_construction.kr_equity_stocks: 770 (NEW alpha sig_dates 184m × 770 tickers); Iter5 1715 alpha 846 tickers overlap
universe_construction.rationale: PD22 design = full cross-universe top20. 모든 자산이 동일 ranking pool 참여 (도훈 mandate 정합)

z_score_per_asset.kr_stock: z_kr = 0.818 × z_1715 + 0.182 × z_NEW (PD20-B weight retain). z_1715 = Iter5 score_eff cross-section z, z_NEW = NEW alpha cross-section z. Both within sig_date.
z_score_per_asset.tsmom_basket: Rolling 36m z-score on TSMOM monthly return (PIT lag 1m)
z_score_per_asset.kr_10y_bond: Rolling 36m z-score on KR_10y monthly return (PIT lag 1m)

top20_selection.method: Cross-universe rank by composite_z descending. Top20 EW 5% each.
top20_selection.etf_count_inclusion: TSMOM_basket / KR_10y_bond count toward 20 names (도훈 mandate cross-universe 정합)

cross_universe_diagnostic.interpretation: KR equity dominance overwhelming (98.5% of slots). ETF/Bond rarely selected. Diversification structure 상실.

delta_pd22_minus_s4.verdict_4axis_strict: ALL FAIL — PD22 inferior on every axis

diebold_mariano.interpretation: PD22 underperforms S4 v2 but NOT statistically significantly (t=-0.09). Implies same mean, but PD22 has much higher variance + MDD.

comparison_vs_pd20b_path2_aligned.interpretation: PD22 strictly INFERIOR to PD20-B Path 2 across all axes. PD20-B's KR equity composite (z_1715+z_NEW top20) + 4-sleeve weighting structure preserves diversification and yields SR 2.31. PD22's cross-universe ranking collapses to KR-only stock-picking with no sleeve hedging.

comparison_vs_pd18_5sleeve_full.interpretation: PD18 5-sleeve (49 holdings, cap violation baseline) also strictly dominates PD22. PD18 retains all 5 sleeve weights (45/10/22.5/18/4.5) so hedging structure preserved.

why_pd22_fails: Cross-universe ranking → KR equity dominance 98.5% (770 vs 9 non-KR candidates). ETF/Bond rarely make top20 due to lower z-scores in normal periods.
Sleeve weighting structure 상실 — 5 sleeve의 hedging diversification 효과 0. PD22는 effectively KR-only stock-picking 18-20 stocks EW 5% each.
Turnover 폭주 (629% annualized vs S4 v2 ~60%) — cross-universe ranking churn 증폭. Cost drag 188 bps/yr.
MDD -33.60% vs S4 v2 -12.63% → 위기 hedge 작동 못함. KR bond hedge가 normal periods에서 미선택되어 위기 발생 시 100% KR equity exposure.
EW 5% each → 1715 alpha의 z-weighted top concentration (anchor 6.83%) gain 상실. Diluted to 5%.
design_critique.structural_root_cause: 도훈 framing '5슬리브 z-composite top20' 은 두 해석 가능: (A) 5 sleeve weighting 자체를 z-norm composite (PD20-B Path 2가 이미 이 instantiation) 또는 (B) 5 sleeve 모든 자산을 cross-universe ranking (PD22). 본 design은 (B) 해석. 결과: KR equity universe size dominance가 sleeve diversification 효과를 완전히 상쇄.

verdict_summary.admit_recommendation: RETAIN current PG2 admit (S4 v2 4-sleeve hybrid 50/25/20/5cash from WT-P20260509_001) OR upgrade to PD20-B Path 2 (4-sleeve consolidation with z-composite KR equity top20 sleeve). PD22 design REJECT.
verdict_summary.key_learning: Cross-universe ranking ≠ sleeve hedging. Universe size dominance (770 KR vs 9 non-KR) makes ETF/Bond effectively excluded. Sleeve weighting structure가 사라지면 multi-asset diversification 효과 상실.
